name: provenance
command:
import json, hashlib, subprocess, sys
with open('/workspace/sentilab/PROVENANCE.json') as f:
    p = json.load(f)
mismatches = 0
missing_blobs = 0
for entry in p['files']:
    blob = entry['git_blob']
    r = subprocess.run(['git', 'cat-file', '-e', blob], cwd='/workspace/sentilab', capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f'BLOB MISSING: {entry["path"]} blob={blob}')
        missing_blobs += 1
        continue
    at_import = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '126507d4dbd8cf327aa158c4dd893c436f7cdf8f:' + entry['path']], cwd='/workspace/sentilab', capture_output=True, text=True)
    if at_import.returncode != 0 or at_import.stdout.strip() != blob:
        print(f'IMPORT TREE MISMATCH: {entry["path"]} is not blob {blob} at 126507d4dbd8cf327aa158c4dd893c436f7cdf8f')
        mismatches += 1
        continue
    r = subprocess.run(['git', 'cat-file', 'blob', blob], cwd='/workspace/sentilab', capture_output=True, text=False)
    actual = hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest()
    if actual != entry['sha256']:
        print(f'SHA256 MISMATCH: {entry["path"]} (expected {entry["sha256"][:16]}... got {actual[:16]}...)')
        mismatches += 1
if missing_blobs > 0:
    raise SystemExit(f'PROVENANCE: {missing_blobs} blobs missing from repo')
if mismatches > 0:
    raise SystemExit(f'PROVENANCE SHA256 MISMATCHES: {mismatches}')
print(f'IMMUTABLE IMPORT VERIFIED: {len(p["files"])} files checked against git blobs at 126507d4dbd8cf327aa158c4dd893c436f7cdf8f, 0 mismatches')
